final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default. A live check of this account on 2026-11-18 confirmed that new EBS disks are encrypted by default in the us-east-1 region.
final_draft.note: The approved answer and the live check agree. The live check covers only us-east-1, the region the tool is set up for, and it says nothing about other regions. The approved answer doesn't name a region, so the answer limits the confirmed part to us-east-1. The approved answer also doesn't call 111122223333 the production account, but another approved answer (answer:b2dde014-859c-460b-b99f-ce7cf0edd2da, about root MFA) does. Please check that us-east-1 is the only region in use for production, or that default encryption is turned on in every other region production uses.
